open.title: Start a task in a worktree
open.body: A worktree gives a task its own checkout and branch, so its agent never touches your main checkout's files.

pick.title: Pick Worktree
pick.body: It opens a session in a new worktree, on a branch of its own.

name.title: Name it
name.body: A few words or an issue like #123, and the branch takes that name. Leave it blank for a random one.

from.title: Pick where it starts
from.body: The branch the worktree starts from. Click it to search your local and remote branches.

create.title: Create it
create.body: lich creates the worktree and opens a session in it.

card.title: A checkout of its own
card.body: The new session sits in its own checkout block, with its branch on the header. Its agent works there without touching your main checkout's files.

branch.title: The branch on screen
branch.body: This chip shows the branch of the session on screen. Click it for its history and branch actions.
